changelog:
✨ MAYA ASSISTANT — WHAT'S NEW

A whole new multilingual experience is here! 🌍

🌐 ONE MAYA. THREE LANGUAGES.

Now Maya speaks your language!

🇮🇳 বাংলা (Bengali)

- সম্পূর্ণ বাংলা ভাষায় Maya ব্যবহার করুন।
- বাংলা Voice Commands ও AI Responses।
- বাংলা Interface এবং Voice Experience।

🇮🇳 हिन्दी (Hindi)

- अब Maya का इस्तेमाल पूरी हिन्दी में करें।
- हिन्दी Voice Commands और AI Responses।
- हिन्दी Interface और Voice Experience।

🇬🇧 English

- Use Maya entirely in English.
- English Voice Commands and AI Responses.
- English Interface and Voice Experience.

More Language Freedom

- New Language Selection Popup on app startup.
- Switch between Bengali, Hindi & English anytime from Settings.
- Your selected language controls the app interface, AI responses, voice announcements and speech recognition.
- A consistent experience across all three languages.

🎨 A FRESH NEW DESIGN

- Modern & Premium UI.
- Improved Glassmorphism Design.
- Cleaner Settings and Features pages.
- Better Cards, Buttons & Navigation.
- Smoother animations and interactions.

👁️ MAYA EYE

- Live Screen Observation.
- Screen-aware assistance.
- Better understanding of what's happening on your phone.

🧠 AI & OTHER IMPROVEMENTS

- Better context understanding.
- More natural conversations.
- Multilingual Smart Alarm.
- Improved time and number pronunciation.
- Stability and permission handling improvements.

Your Language. Your Maya. Your Experience. ❤️

Maya Assistant
Powered by Synthex.
